_about: What personal data OpsEngine holds, why, where and for how long. Lawful bases are PLACEHOLDERS for the solicitor to confirm. Used by `python -m opsengine gdpr inventory` and the record of processing activities.

items.data: name, role, phone, preferred language, trades, sites worked on
items.why: check site-access compliance and contact them about renewals

items.data: card and certificate details (Safe Pass, CSCS, training), photos of cards, site inductions, signed terms
items.retention: leaver_records_years after leaving; review uploads review_uploads_days

items.data: messages sent and received, delivery status
items.why: chase documents, record what was asked and when
items.retention: message files resolved_message_files_years; log entries kept as audit records

items.data: name, email, phone; their insurance and tax documents
name, email, role, password hash, sign-in code secret (staff), sign-in history with IP address
items.why: secure access and an audit trail of who did what

items.data: audit log entries (who did what, when; may include names)
items.why: tamper-evident record for audits and disputes
items.retention: [SOLICITOR] - append-only; personal content is kept out of new entries where possible

items.data: Emails and WhatsApp messages they send in, with attachments (card photos, certificates)
items.why: Receiving the documents we asked for
items.lawful_basis: [SOLICITOR] proposed: legitimate interests / contract with the customer
items.retention: As the document records; rejected review uploads per review_uploads_days

items.who: Anyone who emails or messages the service
items.data: Messages that couldn't be matched to a customer or person, kept for the ops team
items.why: So nothing sent to us is silently lost
items.lawful_basis: [SOLICITOR] proposed: legitimate interests / contract with the customer
items.retention: [SOLICITOR] proposed: delete after 30 days once checked

items.data: WhatsApp opt-out and time of their last message
items.why: Respecting STOP and WhatsApp's 24-hour reply window
items.lawful_basis: [SOLICITOR] proposed: legitimate interests / contract with the customer
items.retention: While they work for the customer; removed with leaver records

items.data: Message text waiting to be sent or retried, address, delivery status
items.where: state/<customer>/state.db, deliveries (text is cleared once sent)
items.why: Retrying failed sends and handling bounces
items.lawful_basis: [SOLICITOR] proposed: legitimate interests / contract with the customer
items.retention: Text cleared once delivered; delivery status kept with the message history

processors.what: card and certificate images, message text for translation and drafting
all of the above, at rest
